in: HoldComplete[BFS[g_Graph, start_Integer] := Module[{e = ToAdjacencyLists[g], bfi = Table[0, {V[g]}], cnt = 1, queue = {start}, parent = Table[i, {i, V[g]}], lvl = Table[Infinity, {V[g]}]}, bfi[[start]] = cnt++; lvl[[start]] = 0; While[queue != {}, {v, queue} = {First[queue], Rest[queue]}; Scan[If[bfi[[#1]] == 0, bfi[[#1]] = cnt++; parent[[#1]] = v; lvl[[#1]] = lvl[[v]] + 1; AppendTo[queue, #1]] & , e[[v]]]]; {bfi, parent, lvl}] /; 1 <= start && start <= V[g]]
